Clouded in mystery, the ''''Quake'''' tournament in the [[BYOC]] area of Dreamhack was assumed to be held in ''Quake Champions''. But with one week before the event started, a news post on Dreamhacks website revealed it was going to be Quakeworld tournament. With such short notice, the news totally missed the greater crowds. But a few picked up on it, and packed their computers to attend this [[LAN]] event.

With great casting from [[Andeh]] and [[Jehar]], we got to see some really entertaining games, with a unusually big amount of them being close ones. 

Rumours of a nameless fear quickly spread as a dark horse, {{player|zsc|flag=se}}, showed off brutal force and huge frag margins in his opening games. This rung the alarm bells to other contenders to be on their guard, watching out for this upcoming player (occasionally spotted at [[FFA]] servers).
